title: GKE 1.33 cluster is past end of standard support
summary: The GKE release schedule lists GKE 1.33 with end of standard support on 2026-08-12 and end of extended support on 2027-06-12. A cluster outside the Extended channel no longer receives patches for this minor version.

constraints: GKE upgrades one minor version at a time and may auto-upgrade a cluster whose version reaches end of support.
Only a cluster in the Extended channel keeps receiving security patches past the end of standard support.
Node pools and the control plane must be on compatible versions, so raise both in the same change.

steps.title: Raise the control-plane version
steps.instructions: Raise the cluster's Kubernetes version to a supported release, or let its release channel do it.

steps.title: Raise the node pools
steps.instructions: Raise every node pool to a compatible version, or let the release channel manage it.

steps.title: Remove APIs the new version deleted
steps.instructions: Read the Kubernetes deprecation guide for every minor version crossed and replace removed API versions before applying.

verification.purpose: Confirm the API server and kubectl agree on the new version.
Confirm every node runs a compatible version.
